references.text: The Lord spoke to Moses with the same introductory formula, marking the beginning of divine instructions about the tabernacle.
Repeated formula where the Lord speaks to Moses to give further instructions about the sanctuary.
The same introductory formula is used when God gives Moses instructions on building the tabernacle.
The Lord called to Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting, showing the continuation of God's communication after the tabernacle was erected.
The Lord spoke to Moses in the tent of meeting, linking God's speech with the completed tabernacle.
Confirms Moses' unique position as a prophet whom the Lord spoke with face to face.
